title: Fourier coefficients of the two-coordinate indicator
statement: Let $\phi_0,\phi_1,\phi_2$ be the orthonormal Fourier functions on the equally weighted three-point set, and let $g$ be the indicator of the point $c$, so $g(c)=1$ and $g(a)=g(b)=0$. For each pair of indices $a_0,a_1\in\{0,1,2\}$, the Fourier coefficient of the function $(x_0,x_1)\mapsto g(x_0)g(x_1)$ in the product basis $\phi_{a_0}(x_0)\phi_{a_1}(x_1)$ equals $\widehat g(a_0)\widehat g(a_1)$, where $\widehat g(0)=1/3$, $\widehat g(1)=-\sqrt2/6$, and $\widehat g(2)=-\sqrt6/6$.
hypotheses_covered: The index assignment has two coordinates, each in $\{0,1,2\}$
